chunks: And not known is my account!

key_terms.حِسَابِيَهْ: My account/reckoning (referring to the accounting of deeds by God)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when one does not know their account (hisab) in the context of the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase captures the profound humility of the believer who, despite striving for righteousness, remains uncertain of their ultimate standing before God, reflecting the balance between hope (rajā') and fear (khawf). It underscores the concept of *Hisab* (accounting) not merely as a legal reckoning but as a spiritual reckoning where even the righteous seek God's mercy over their own deeds. This uncertainty serves as a safeguard against spiritual arrogance (*istikbār*), a key virtue in Shia ethics.
